row: A Better Life Animal Sanctuary is a forever home based in Perth, Western Australia for farm animals and others who have been rescued or adopted. Sadly many of our animals were saved from abuse or neglect and as a result we hope to educate and raise awareness of living a conscious, ethical life that excludes the exploitation of animals. Oh, and we like cute animal photos just as much as you do!
